newsitem.title: AFGHANISTAN: New Afghan rulers hang two more ex-officials.
newsitem.headline: New Afghan rulers hang two more ex-officials.

text.p: Afghanistan's new self-declared Taleban government said on Saturday it had hanged two more members of a former communist government.

The official Kabul Radio said the two "accomplices" of the executed former president Najibullah had been hanged on Friday evening, naming them as Najibullah's bodyguard, General Jafsar, and his aide Tokhi.
The two men had been living with Najibullah, who was hanged with his brother Shahpur Ahmadzai soon after the Taleban forces entered Kabul on Friday.
All four had been housed at a United Nations compound in Kabul since Najibullah was ousted in April 1992.
The fly-blown bodies of Najibullah and his brother were still hanging on Saturday from a concrete traffic post outside the presidential palace in Kabul, more than 36 hours after their execution.
But there was no sign of the bodies of Jafsar and Tokhi.
